Blueface is a Los Angeles rapper and internet personality whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter. He broke through nationally in 2018 with “Thotiana,” which became his biggest mainstream hit and later received high-profile remixes. Known for his unconventional flow and West Coast sound, Blueface has collaborated with artists including Cardi B, YG, Lil Baby, Gunna, and NLE Choppa. Beyond music, he has remained a major social-media personality, with his relationships, family life, livestreams, and other viral moments frequently drawing attention online.

Chrisean Rock is a rapper, reality-TV personality, and social-media figure from Baltimore, Maryland. Her full name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone. She initially gained wider attention through Blueface’s “Blue Girls Club” and later built her own following through music, reality television, and viral social-media moments. She became particularly well known through the Zeus Network series Baddies and Crazy in Love, which documented parts of her relationship with Blueface. She has also released music, including “Vibe,” and developed a large online fanbase.

Blueface and Chrisean Rock have had a highly publicized, on-and-off relationship for years, and they share a son, Chrisean Jesus Malone Jr., born in 2023. Their relationship has played out heavily across social media, livestreams, and reality television, making them one of the more recognizable celebrity couples in internet culture.
